brief: BeaverMeter is a native macOS menu-bar utility that monitors AI coding-service usage. Preserve the beaver identity, friendliness and front-incisor recognition while replacing detailed illustration with compact rounded graphic shapes. Existing app UI and seasonal rules remain unchanged.
model: Not exposed by the tool interface; user explicitly approved the built-in tool.
policy: Generate each of A1–C2 exactly once, independently without image references. Preserve and deliver every returned result unmodified. User chooses the master before production adaptation.

productionAfterSelection.finder: Selected solid background and corner-emergence composition.
productionAfterSelection.popover: Complete centered transparent avatar and eight matching seasonal outfits.
productionAfterSelection.menu: One shared monochrome outline derived from the selected character.

candidates.label: A1
candidates.rationale: 延续 BeaverMeter 温暖亲切的感觉，用宽圆脸和短门牙减少小尺寸细节。
candidates.prompt:
Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 × 1536.
Background: fill the entire square with solid gently muted sage teal #7EB9AE. Keep this background visible in every open area and in the corners not occupied by the character; the assigned emergence corner must be occupied by the character.
Subject: place one extremely simplified, cute, endearing beaver head on the background, reduced to one soft rounded continuous silhouette and one defining feature: the pair of front incisors. Use a wide oval head, broad soft cheeks, two round ears and two short, blunt front incisors; a calm friendly expression. Keep both ears and both teeth visible.
Complexity: use only 4–7 large basic shapes and at most two broad internal color regions. Use two simple eyes and one tiny mouth only as needed to express the incisors. Remove every nonessential line, outline, anatomical detail, texture, whisker, fur tuft, eyebrow and decoration. Keep the character readable at 32 × 32.
Color behavior: use exactly three semantic colors in the complete image: exactly two character base colors, warm chestnut brown #6F3D25 and warm cream #FFE8BE, plus the background color. Use the first character color as the main head mass and simple facial marks, and the second as one broad muzzle region and the front incisors. Reuse these character colors rather than adding a separate facial color. Keep the head, facial marks and background clearly separated.
Composition: keep the character upright and emerging from the assigned lower-left, filling about 85–95% of the square so it remains visually dominant. Gentle cropping at the bottom or assigned side is welcome when it strengthens the corner emergence, while keeping both ears and the defining incisors visible. Never center or bottom-center the character. Show only the head, without a body.
Style: make simplification, cuteness, and lovable baby-like appeal the strongest qualities. Use large soft forms, compact proportions, thick rounded contours, and an ultra-clean graphic treatment. Prefer one clear shape over several explanatory details. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Finish: show only the character on the full-canvas background, with clean surfaces and normal square outer corners.
Constraints: Use no text or watermark. Add no borders, frames, cards, or presentation masks. Include one character only, with no extra subjects or scenery. Use no fragile lines, sharp tips, unnecessary outlines, tiny details, or decorative marks. Add no photorealistic material, dramatic bevel, glossy hotspot, deep occlusion, extrusion, strong three-dimensional rendering, or external cast shadow. Keep the background solid and uniform, with no texture, vignette, or lighting variation.
